featured_reviews.name: Nitin Sakpal
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited here after span of 12 years. So many things have been changed now. This temple come up with maximum facilities to devotees. In fact temple authority also installed a lift which can carry 5-7 persons inside temple. It's a huge relief for senior citizens and who are physically challenged. A nice peaceful place to visit on your list. To reach here you have many options, from Naugaon, Juchandra railway station as well from Mumbai Ahmedabad Highway.

featured_reviews.name: gauri langote
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chandika Devi Mandir, Dapoli: A Spiritual Retreat

Chandika Devi Mandir, located in Dapoli, Maharashtra, is a revered temple dedicated to Goddess Chandika, an incarnation of Goddess Durga. The temple sits amidst scenic surroundings, offering a peaceful atmosphere for devotees and visitors. The idol of Goddess Chandika is believed to be powerful and is worshipped for protection, strength, and spiritual well-being.

The temple’s serene location, surrounded by lush greenery, adds to its spiritual charm. It is a perfect spot for those seeking a spiritual retreat and a connection to nature, making it a must-visit for religious pilgrims and nature lovers alike.
